senses: to be displeased, be angry, fret oneself, be wroth
(Qal) to be wroth, to be full of wrath, to be furious
(Hiphil) to provoke to wrath or anger
(Hithpael) to put oneself in a rage, anger oneself

strongs.def: to crack off, i.e. (figuratively) burst out in rage
strongs.kjv: (be) anger(-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth
